_meta.description: Newsroom Stability Harness golden regression corpus. Single source of truth read by both the golden suite runner (tests/golden/, tests/test_news_golden_suite.py) and scripts/run_news_golden_suite.py - never duplicated. Every case in `cases` carries a `provenance` field pointing to the phase/report/test the real evidence was taken from. `failure_class` is one of: real_regression (a confirmed real production defect, now fixed - this fixture pins the fix), known_limitation (a confirmed real defect/gap, deliberately NOT fixed this phase - asserts CURRENT behavior honestly, never falsely marked fixed), good_control (a clean, correct case, real or representative-synthetic), negative_control (must NOT trigger the behavior under test). `kind` is one of: deterministically_testable (offline, no live model needed) or requires_live_validation (documents what this case cannot prove offline). See docs/newsroom_stability_harness_checkpoint.md for the full design.
_meta.schema_note: Each case's `expected` dict is compared against the runner's returned `actual` dict by tests/golden/invariants.py::evaluate_expectations(). Plain keys are exact-equality. A `<key>__in` key checks membership against a list. A `<key>__contains`/`<key>__not_contains` key checks substring presence/absence. A `<key>__gte`/`<key>__lte` key checks a numeric bound.

cases.name: Zoom vulnerability, two publishers: the scorer alone would NOT have caught this pair either (known limitation, newly surfaced by this harness)
cases.provenance: docs/phase23_1o_final_2h_combined_news_canary_report.md §11, §13. Post #3 (9to5Mac, 15:31 UTC) and Post #14 (The Verge, 16:44 UTC), 73 minutes apart, both delivered as separate NEWS posts with story_id=null because story_memory_mode=off (a config-gate root cause). This golden case was originally written expecting the scorer to catch the pair once the gate is disregarded; running it against the real, unmodified score_candidate() (measured while building this harness) found combined=0.05, entity_overlap=0.0 - the two headlines share almost no title/entity text ('Zoom' vs 'Zoomsday' are different capitalized-run tokens). This is a SECOND, independent, previously-undocumented known limitation this harness surfaced: even with story_memory_mode enabled, this specific pair would still land as new_story from title/entity text alone. Documented honestly, not silently marked fixed.

cases.name: US AI productivity headline: hedged-but-not-keyword-matched Intelligence recommendation must still be recognized as weak evidence
cases.provenance: docs/news_output_stability_forensic_report.md §2 (Case A) - same real instance as google_news_wrapper_unresolved (draft 442b7fd2..., event 0527dbc9...). Intelligence recommendation (real text): '...перед выпуском необходимо получить полный текст исследования... Не подавать тему как доказанное массовое повышение производительности без этих данных' - did NOT contain any of the exact negative-recommendation keyword markers ('не публиковать' etc.), so _is_negative_recommendation() returned False and treatment stayed BRIEF instead of SKIP.
